register_entity_as_egocentric: register a pycolab game entity as egocentric within a scrolling group
retrieve_current_scrolling_order: retrieve the current scrolling order for a scrolling group if one exists
permit_next_permissible_motions: indicate the next permissible scrolling motions for an egocentric entity
check_if_scrolling_motion_is_legal: check whether a scrolling order is legal for all egocentric entities in a scrolling group
issue_scrolling_order: issue a scrolling order for all participants in a scrolling group
